card.name: Mixed spots in imaging and procedure text
card.fires_on: Short words or word parts inside imaging, radiation and injection-procedure text, such as the space after Figure, the word hand in surgical hand disinfection, or the 9 in Tc99m. No single word type unites them.

modes.label: After Figure
modes.description: The space right after the word Figure, before the figure number.

modes.label: Inside injection and imaging phrases
modes.description: A word inside a fixed procedure or radiopharmaceutical phrase, such as surgical hand disinfection or Tc99m.
modes.example: which include surgical<< hand>> disinfection and the use of sterile gloves

modes.label: Linking words in radiation text
modes.description: Small words like and, the or lower in sentences about radiation exposure or certification.
modes.example: minimize radiation exposure to the patient<< and>> healthcare providers

card.writes: No clear link between the promoted and suppressed tokens, though the suppressed ones (chart, case, abstract) suggest it steers away from those nouns.
card.plain: It fires on assorted small words in imaging, radiation and injection-procedure passages, with no single clear theme.
